BiblicalUsage: Parangelia is the charge, the commandment, the mandate given. The end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned; Paul charges Timothy to war a good warfare according to the prophecies; and the council charges the apostles not to teach in the name of Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that every charge is judged by its end. Paul's command ends in love from a pure heart, and the council's command ends in silencing the name — and I know which charge I answer to.
